product.name: Aurelio SnapShot 45mm Prime
product.description: The Aurelio SnapShot 45mm Prime delivers sharp, high‑contrast imagery for both stills and video. With a wide f/1.8 aperture, the lens excels in low‑light scenes, producing shallow depth of field and pleasing bokeh. A compact 7.5‑cm barrel houses a 9‑element optical design, including two ultra‑low‑dispersion glass elements that reduce chromatic aberration. The metal‑alloy mount provides robust compatibility with Canon EF, Sony E, and Fujifilm X systems, while a lightweight 0.45‑kg body keeps the setup balanced for handheld shooting. An integrated optical image‑stabilization module offers up to 3 stops of shake compensation, making it suitable for handheld video. The matte black finish adds a professional look to any kit.
